[EN] Supposedly there was a big riot to the north, around the Freeholds. Supplies were having trouble getting through for a while.

Don't know how much of a concern it is now, but it'd be useful to know whether any shipments of mine are going to get through. If you're headed that way, would you mind checking it out for me?

Check in with Teomath—he trades with the farmers pretty often, and is likely to have any information worth having.
[ES] Supuestamente hubo un gran disturbio al norte, por los Freeholds. Los suministros tuvieron problemas para pasar durante un tiempo.

No sé qué tan preocupante sea ahora, pero sería útil saber si alguno de mis cargamentos va a poder pasar. Si vas hacia allá, ¿te importaría comprobarlo por mí?

Habla con Teomath; comercia con los granjeros muy a menudo y es probable que tenga información útil.

[EN] That riot was pretty bad indeed. I couldn't tell you if it's safe to go back there yet—I haven't had the nerve to risk finding out.

You could take that fancy weapon of yours, though, and maybe find out if things have calmed down."I can do that."
[ES] Esos disturbios fueron bastante graves. No sabría decirte si ya es seguro volver allí; no he tenido el valor de arriesgarme a averiguarlo.

Sin embargo, podrías llevar esa elegante arma tuya y ver si las cosas se han calmaron."I can do that."

[EN] If you go straight following the North Gate over there, you'll see Casidhe's Stand. Cardis is stationed there, and should have more information. "Got it."
[ES] Si sigues derecho pasando la North Gate de allí, verás Casidhe's Stand. Cardis está apostado allí y debería tener más información. "Got it."

[EN] Ah, you're here about the riot—and, I hope, to talk supply shipments.
[ES] Ah, estás aquí por los disturbios y, espero, para hablar de los envíos de suministros.
